fitlog.notes: Fit Log 2.2: photo guessing. Tap a pending photo, then "Guess from photo" — the app sends the picture to Google's Gemini (your own free key, pasted once in Settings) and guesses the food AND the portions, like Juno does in chat, then asks "Is this right?" No = tell it what it really was and it guesses again. The name lookup from 2.1 is still there too.
